decisions.reason: A has its own page, a flagship government client in the UK Home Office and connections to over 30 government APIS schemes, so both investment and public commitment are high and dropping it is very unlikely.

Demand for travel health requirements has faded since the pandemic, but the dedicated page and the API investment encourage management to blame weak results on temporary market conditions and keep it.
The awareness training module is only mentioned on the website and is cheap to maintain, and it fits the firm's security direction, so there is little pressure to remove it.
Behaviour analysis is central to the firm's security identity and likely reflects substantial past investment, so management will keep it even without results reported.
The passenger profiling method is closely tied to the firm's core aviation security methodology, so its strategic centrality supports keeping it.
The verification web platform has its own page and complements the passenger data offering, so public commitment and fit with the announced direction favour keeping it.
